hypotheticalOnly: If c does not intersect b, a and c would be two distinct parallels to b through A. This is refuted, not actual geometry.
modernAdditions: Remove scan noise and regularize a and b to exact horizontal parallel straight strokes, justified by the actual given.
Use semantic ink, consistent vector strokes and English/math labels of at least 16 CSS px at widths 300, 358 and 640.
Retain hidden marker for A because source does not print a separate point dot; renderer owns its visible label.
multiPointRequirement: Only one named source point; native two-point group requirement is inapplicable. Its incident strokes use literal endpoints, not invented source points.
unresolved: Native FigureSpec has no logical hypothetical/nonintersection assertion; c-does-not-meet-b is preserved as proof-only prose and cannot be certified as actual geometry.
